book.name: Lukas
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Lukas byex o

content: Qayeeng pakeing wei vexeiv ti mi wo lukendu wou tambiy wei mi zeim qayeeng o
Woyom Yesu neil qayeeng pakeing tine wou e xe xel betiyeing, bei e talex wou xel en xel a mi zeimemend taxombouk, de xel se bo nimaing.
Moxo neil embei, “Eivek beyeeng ti eno tambiy wei mi zeim qayeeng o ti mindei, wei se mi yaleeng en Anutu, me se mi wounalei en moux alis vex.
De vexeiv ti mindei eivek beyeeng tiyon. Om mi qatoloum wou tambiy wei mi ngo qayeeng o. Vexo neil, ‘Tambiy ti embei bo vevek wou ay. Om wa menyex wou qayeeng eivek uw senghoing.’
“Myaxeeng eno tambiy wei mi ngo qayeeng eno se vind vexo. Dekakom moxo wounalei bei, ‘A se xaleeng en Anutu me a se wou kwang en xomaxoneing ti.
Ekom a xei vexeiv tiyon mi wo maying wou ay me qou e xe nimaying me lam wou ay, om a menyex wou qayeeng enok bo nimbayaing wou ay.’”
De Tambiy Ngandoung neil embei, “Xam ngo qayeeng wei tambiy nilul wei mi zeim qayeeng eno neil o.
De tyek Anutu menyex wou xomaxoneing wei e beyal o, me xel mi eng wou e bendiyeing aluw boukeing o, tyek na mi daxe de se devind xel daing?
A neil wou xam, tyek gyei me menyex wou xel daing. Ekom gyeik bouk wei Xomaxoneing Neu Moux embei noum eno tyek gyei bei moux alis vex wei tembuing ne di wongis e?”
Qayeeng pakeing wei Parisi me tambiy wei mi qou takis o
Yesu neil qayeeng pakeing tine en xel valu wei mi wou naleind bei xel venaxow bombek de xel valu se nimza nambei xel.
“Tambiy yayuw lek me la eivek xomek vambuing en embei na zeimemend, nge Parisi ti de nge xel wei mi qou takis o.
Parisi tiyon nale me zeimema en xow: ‘O Anutu, a wong dange lak wou wang, en a se nambei moux amba, xel mi panax me mi wo nilul me mi wong kwapesiv, de a se nambei tambiy tiwei mi qou takis ne.
Bouk yayuw eivek sounda sapa eno a mi vambu yaeing, me na mi wong ti eivek xoumeeng en lul dalus wei a mi qou eno wou wang.’
“Ekom tambiy wei mi qou takis eno qandi lek me nale kwanding de se yeima la tyoung gheyapu nei, qe qatu bambou me neil embei, ‘Anutu, a mi wong sewokeing om wa laleim e pyaxow en ay.’

“A neil wou xam en tambiy tiwei mi qou takis on bei, gyeik lox beeng nei eno Anutu yei bei e bombek wou e manghalus. Dom Parisi eno ma. En xelti embei sanghoxe xow eno Anutu tyek beoux e, de xelti embei beoux xow eno Anutu tyek sanghoxe e.”
Yesu is xel yakyak
Xomaxoneing valu qou yakyak me la wou Yesu, xel embei e ni mema lek xel. Ekom gyeik ingwei xel betiyeing yei, eno xel neil xel.
Ekom Yesu taxe yakyak lam wou e de neil embei, “Xam ghe bong yakyak nam wou ay, xam se bale zeyi xel, en Anutu xe tete lalei nei eno xel wei xok ambei yakyak eno xel xe.
A neil wou xam zonghek, xelti embei se qou Anutu xe tete lalei nambei yakyak ne, eno tyek se na eivek.”
Gyovaxa wei lulul ana yo ti luk is Yesu
Gyovaxa ti teling wou Yesu bei, “Putoung nimza, tyek a bong vati de na qou deing mapieing luta luta?”
Yesu lewexe, “Nambei nya wang neimbei a nimza? Xelti se nimza qe Anutu venaxow.
Wang woulek qayeeng petieing: ‘Wa seng bo kwapesiv is xel nge, wa seng nyeis xel nge na mey, wa se panax, wa seng bong qayeeng tyonyeing en xel nge. Wa mi gwevek mam aluw tam xeinghembi.’”
Gyovaxa neil, “Gyeik a yak me elam tyip gweimbeeng ne, eno a mi betiwou petieing on dalus.”

Gyeik ingwei Yesu ngo inyon, eno neil wou e bei, “Wang ghei ma en lulti. Wang bo vateivek lek lulul dalus wei wang o, de ghe bong malew on wou xel kanyo, on tyek wa qou lulul nimzamza eivek tyoung gheyapu nei, woyom wang nam betiwou ay.”
Gyeik ingwei moxo ngo inyon eno lalei wo maying, en nambei tambiy yon xe lulul ngenong.
Yesu yei e me neil embei, “Inye wo pok en xel wei lulul ana embei na eivek Anutu xe tete lalei yo!
Wangwei kamel embei na eivek ying manghalus wei duweing lulul o ond tyek bo pok wou e? Ekom xel wei lulul ana embei na eivek Anutu xe tete lalei eno tyek bo pok ngandoung.”
Xel wei ngo inyon eno teling bei, “Wangwei nambei nyon nei ond tyek eti na mendei mapieing luta luta?”
Yesu neil elox bei, “Lulul wei xomaxoneing se teyeimbei bong eno Anutu teyeimbei tyek bong.”
Petele neil wou embei, “Wei, xa ghanaw xa xe lulul dalus de betiy wang.”
Yesu neil wou xel bei, “A neil wou xam zonghek, xelti embei saing beeng o venei o liyeiw o mamata o neuyeiw en Anutu xe tete lalei
on tyek xel a qou lul ngenong lumama lek bouk tine, me bouk wei embei nam eno tyek xel a qou deing mapieing luta luta.”
Yesu neil e xe meyeing teyei no
Yesu qou xel xoumeeng yuw me la nale beyaleing me neil wou xel. “Xey ambei zek me nana Yerusalem, me lulul dalus wei xel poropet byex lek Xomaxoneing Neu Moux eno tyek bo neing lek.
Tyek xel toung moxo na eivek xel amba memend. Tyek xel baluk seloukeing wou e, me bo nol wou e, me pesuv myenlouk lek e,
me sesa e, de nyeis e mey. Ekom lek bouk yal eno tyek qandi lek no.”
Xel betiyeing se woulek qayeeng tine qes en qes xupek en xel, me xel se woulek vati wei di neil o.
Yesu wong tambiy wei matekeing o ti ma wo nimzalek
Ka Yesu la paviy beyeeng Jeriko, eno tambiy wei matekeing o ti mindei wou sakwaing nenyawes me mi tay lulul me malew wou xel.
Gyeik ingwei moxo ngo moux alis vex ngenongakes di lam, om teling wou xel bei, “Inyei xel di wo vati?”
Xel neil wou embei, “Yesu wei Nasaret eno di lamela.”
Matekeing moxo taxe bei, “Yesu, Dawit Neu Moux,
wa laleim e pyaxow en ay.”
Xel wei di lam atax eno neil e me neil embei e mendei kanzek, ekom moxo taxe xoulekeing, “Dawit Neu moux, wa laleim e pyaxow en ay.”
Yesu nale me neil nikanzek bei xel a qou moux tiyon me na wou e. Gyeik ingwei moxo la paviy, Yesu teling e,
“Wambei am bong vati wou wang?” Moxo neil embei, “Tambiy Ngandoung, ambei gheina yo.”
Yesu neil wou moxo bei, “Wa mam e gyeina en wa xe wongeingis wong wang wo nimzalek.”
Lutika eno moxo ma yeila de betiwou Yesu, me di sanghoxe Anutu. Gyeik ingwei xomaxoneing dalus yei inyon eno xel sanghoxe Anutu.
